recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Board Authorizes $1 Billion Share Repurchase Program
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients takes material from the animal agriculture and food industries and transforms them into valuable ingredients; the company operates over 260 facilities and produces about 30% of the world's collagen and is one of the largest producers of renewable energy. Board authorization of share buyback signals confidence in operational momentum.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients: From Used Cooking Oil to Renewable Fuels Through Chick-fil-A Partnership
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients generated approximately 1.1 million gallons of renewable diesel from used cooking oil collected from more than 2,000 Chick-fil-A restaurants through a strategic partnership. The company continues to expand UCO feedstock collection and conversion to renewable fuels at scale.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Dublin, Georgia Facility: Capturing Methane from Wastewater Treatment as Renewable Natural Gas
recent_news.summary: At its rendering facility in Dublin, Georgia, Darling Ingredients is capturing methane from wastewater treatment and selling it back to the local Municipal Gas Authority as renewable natural gas. This demonstrates innovation in converting waste streams to renewable energy.

recent_news.headline: The 5 Must-Haves for a Vacuum Truck Rental
recent_news.summary: Article on vacuum truck rental requirements and best practices for septic and grease pumping operations.

recent_news.headline: Product Focus: Sewer Cleaning, Inspection and Utility Locating Equipment
recent_news.summary: Product focus article covering equipment and technologies for sewer system cleaning, inspection and utility location in wastewater operations.

recent_news.headline: How Restaurant FOG Becomes a Recyclable Stream Instead of a Sewer Problem
recent_news.summary: Article discusses restaurant FOG as an under-collected recyclable stream and explores how grease-trap waste is moving toward digestion and energy recovery rather than traditional sewer problems. Covers the distinction between used cooking oil (UCO) and grease trap waste.

recent_news.headline: FOG and Consent Decrees: Prevention and Compliance Insights
recent_news.summary: Article discusses how FOG-related sanitary sewer overflows can trigger federal consent decrees. Cities including Baltimore, St. Louis Sewer District, Miami-Dade County, and Fort Smith have had FOG specifically named in consent decrees requiring formal control programs.

backfill_news.headline: GFL Environmental Q2 2026: Revenue Up 11.35%, Organic Growth Accelerates
backfill_news.summary: GFL Environmental second-quarter revenue increased 16.3% from the prior year, including 6.4% organic growth. Organic growth accelerated 180 basis points from Q1 as pricing and fuel-related surcharge revenue offset volume and commodity pressures.

backfill_news.headline: Clean Harbors Secures $600M Long-Term Manufacturing Disposal Contract
backfill_news.summary: Clean Harbors secured a significant 10-year disposal contract valued at $600 million, with expected full ramp-up to $80-100 million annual revenue by 2030. The contract covers incineration waste and complex wastewater volumes, representing a strategic growth opportunity.

backfill_news.headline: Clean Harbors Posts Q2 Beat, Lifts Outlook; SKSS Shows 40%+ Growth
backfill_news.summary: Adjusted EBITDA rose 22% to $409 million, while management lifted full-year 2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance to $1.35 billion to $1.41 billion, up $110 million from prior guidance. SKSS segment delivered over 40% top-line growth.

backfill_news.headline: CDL Driver Class A / Field Laborer – Environmental Services
backfill_news.summary: Miller Environmental Group is seeking CDL Class A drivers and field laborers for environmental services operations in Baltimore, MD, including waste transport, industrial cleaning, and spill response.
